translation: The affairs of the world have long been ruined by mediocre people, and mediocre physicians are the same. What is called mediocre are all people who do not learn and have no skill. When they encounter a matter, at first they do not clarify the source of the disease received, nor do they examine the method of treating it, but either they nourish the abscess with indulgence or they try it rashly and recklessly.
